steps.title: Directory admin (web) — households: list, search, create/edit, photo, privacy toggles, head of house, leader notes
steps.goal: A directory administrator (any member holding `users.create` or `org.settings`) opens `/o/<slug>/directory`, searches the church's households, creates a household, edits its address/phone/anniversary, uploads a household photo to the `directory-photos` bucket, reads and writes the household's leader notes, designates the head of house, and flips the three privacy toggles (`hide_from_fellowship`, `hide_from_congregation`, `show_children_in_fellowship`) subject to the direction rule (admins only toward more privacy) with the family-confirmation state visible. Every read goes through the `directory_households` / `directory_persons` views and every write through the `save_household`, `set_household_privacy`, `save_leader_notes` and `save_person` RPCs. Persons CRUD, congregation status and account linking are step 5.1b.
steps.prompt:
You are working in the ChurchAppCLD repository. CLAUDE.md loads `new_session_instructions.md` and `HANDOFF.md` automatically — follow the session-start checklist (new-session.sh, prompt_history.txt). Work on `main` unless I have named another branch in this session. This is step 5.1a "Directory admin (web) — households: list, search, create/edit, photo, privacy toggles, head of house, leader notes" of `docs/TODO.md`; read that step's 'Done when' list first. Read `docs/PLAN.md` §4 (Directory tables, `app.*` helpers, Client RPCs, permission mapping), §5 ("Directory rule, stated once"), §6 (`directory-photos` bucket), §8 and §11 item (1), and `docs/DESIGN.md` §4.2 (Directory tables), §4.4 section (6) (the three views), §5 (permission mapping table, household self-service paragraph), §6 (households/persons/leader-notes rows of the policy table, storage policies), §7 (bucket table) and §9 before writing code. Also read `docs/RLS.md` (directory visibility matrix) and the bodies of `save_household`, `set_household_privacy`, `save_leader_notes`, `app.guard_household_privacy_columns` and `app.can_edit_household` in `supabase/migrations/9999_init.sql`. Build ONLY this step; do not start the next one.

## Goal
When you finish, a member who holds `users.create` or `org.settings` (the "directory admin" mapping — PLAN §4: "directory admin = `users.create` or `org.settings`") sees a **Directory** entry in the org navigation and can: list and search households at `/o/<slug>/directory`; create a household at `/o/<slug>/directory/households/new`; open `/o/<slug>/directory/households/<householdId>` to edit name, address, home phone, anniversary and sort key, upload or replace the household photo, read/write the leader notes, designate the head of house among the household's adults, and change the three privacy toggles within the direction rule while seeing whether the family has confirmed its privacy choices. The household page also lists the household's persons (read-only cards linking to `/o/<slug>/directory/persons/<personId>`, a route that 5.1b creates — until then the link may 404). Lint, typecheck, unit tests, the web build and the Playwright smoke project are green.

## Inputs / prior state
- Steps 3.1–3.2b built the org shell: `apps/web/app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/layout.tsx`, `requireOrgMember(slug)` → `OrgContext = {org: {orgId, slug, name, status}, membershipStatus, personId, householdId, permissions, isSuperAdmin}`, `requirePerm(ctx, perm | perms[])` (array = any-of), `isWritable(ctx)` / `requireWritable(ctx)`, `src/features/org/nav.ts` (`NAV_ITEMS` with `requires?: PermissionKey[]` any-of), `src/lib/storage/signed-url.ts` (`getSignedUrl(bucket, path, expiresIn)`), `src/lib/dates.ts` (`formatDateOnly`, `formatInstantInZone`), the `ActionResult` / `toActionError` Server Action convention, the logo upload pattern in `src/features/settings/*` (3.1: Server Action writes the planned path, browser uploads with the user client) and `/o/[orgSlug]/users?invite=<personId>` / `?create=<personId>` (3.2b) which 5.1b will link to.
- `@church/db` (1.7a): `queries/directory.ts` — `listHouseholds(orgId, { query, limit, offset })` from `directory_households` ordered by `sort_key, name`, `getHousehold(id)`, `listPersonsForHousehold(householdId)` from `directory_persons`, `getHouseholdWithPersons`, `getHouseholdLeaderNotes`, `getPersonLeaderNotes`, `getPrivacyState(householdId)` (masked `hide_from_fellowship`, `hide_from_congregation`, `show_children_in_fellowship`, `privacy_confirmed_at`, `view_level`); RPC wrappers `saveHousehold(db, { payload })` → uuid, `savePerson(db, { payload })` → uuid, `setHouseholdPrivacy(db, { hh, hide_fell, hide_cong, show_children })`, `saveLeaderNotes(db, { kind, id, notes })`; `queryKeys.directory.households(orgId, query)`, `.directory.household(id)`, `.directory.persons(householdId)`; `unwrap*` helpers. The 1.7a test asserts the directory module never touches the `persons`/`households` base tables — keep that true.
- `@church/domain` (1.6a/1.6b): `saveHouseholdSchema` (keys `id?`, `org_id?`, `name`, `address_line1`, `address_line2`, `city`, `region`, `postal_code`, `country` default `US`, `home_phone`, `photo_path`, `anniversary`, `sort_key`), `savePersonSchema`, `setHouseholdPrivacySchema`, `householdPhotoPath(orgId, householdId, uuid)` → `{org_id}/households/{id}/{uuid}.jpg`, `BUCKETS`, `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS`, `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS`, `toDomainError` / `DomainError`, `mapStorageErrorMessage`, error keys `invalid_payload`, `upload_mime_not_allowed`, `upload_too_large_for_plan`, `organization_suspended`.
- Database facts (`9999_init.sql`): `households (id, org_id, name, address_line1, address_line2, city, region, postal_code, country default 'US', home_phone, photo_path, anniversary, sort_key, hide_from_fellowship default false, hide_from_congregation default false, show_children_in_fellowship default false, privacy_confirmed_by, privacy_confirmed_at, created_via default 'admin')` with check `photo_path like org_id || '/households/' || id || '/%'`; `household_leader_notes (household_id pk, org_id, notes, updated_by, updated_at)`; `persons.household_role` enum `head | spouse | child | other` with the partial unique index "at most one `head` per household" (orchestrator decision 6). Views: `directory_households` exposes `anniversary_display` (`YYYY-MM-DD` for `admin`/`household` level, `MM-DD` for `congregation`), the privacy columns only at `admin`/`household` level, and `view_level`; `directory_persons` exposes `birthday_display`, `youth_override`/`member_since` (admin only) and `view_level`. Column-level grants: `select birthdate from persons` and `anniversary from households` fail with 42501 for `authenticated` — never select them from the base tables. Writes to `households`, `persons` and the notes tables are RPC-only. `save_household(payload jsonb)`: inserts require directory admin and `org_id` in the payload; unknown keys → `invalid_payload`; admin-created households get `hide_from_fellowship = true` ("Admin-created households get `hide_from_fellowship = true` by default"). `set_household_privacy(hh, hide_fell, hide_cong, show_children)`: the `app.guard_household_privacy_columns` trigger enforces founder decision 1 — "household adults any direction (stamps `privacy_confirmed_*`); directory admins only toward more privacy; super admin any; audited". `save_leader_notes(kind, id, notes)`: `kind in ('household','person')`, directory admin only. `save_person` by a directory admin may set any `household_role`.
- Founder decisions that apply: decision 1 — "Families may hide from their OWN congregation too → `households.hide_from_congregation` gets a real UI toggle (household adults any direction; org admins only toward more privacy; super admin any)" — this step ships that toggle for admins (DESIGN §9's "hidden in UI" sentence is superseded; say so in HANDOFF). Decision 2 — fellowship viewers see everything the congregation sees minus birth year, anniversary year and leader notes. HANDOFF "Decisions": "admin-entered households start hidden from the fellowship until a family adult confirms; leaders can only make a family *more* private". Decision 6 — one `head` per household; "Directory admins and household adults may set it (step 5.1 / 5.2)".

## Build
1. **Navigation and guard.** Add `{ href: '/directory', label: 'Directory', requires: ['users.create', 'org.settings'] }` to `NAV_ITEMS` (uncomment the placeholder if 3.1 left one). Create `src/lib/auth/require-directory-admin.ts` exporting `requireDirectoryAdmin(ctx)` = `requirePerm(ctx, ['users.create', 'org.settings'])` and `isDirectoryAdmin(ctx)`; every page and Server Action in this step calls `requireOrgMember(orgSlug)` then `requireDirectoryAdmin(ctx)`, and mutating actions also `requireWritable(ctx)` (suspended/cancelled churches are read-only; the 3.1 `StatusBanner` already explains why). Non-admin members who type the URL get the 3.1 403 page. The member-facing web directory (`(me)` routes) is optional in DESIGN §11 and is NOT built here.
2. **Households list** `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/directory/page.tsx` + `src/features/directory/HouseholdsPage.tsx`: server-rendered first page through `listHouseholds(orgId, { query, limit: 50, offset })` with `?q=` and `?page=` search params (the query matches household name; add a `persons` name search by also calling `listPersons(orgId, { query })` and merging the matching persons' households — de-duplicate by household id). Columns: photo thumbnail (signed URL via `getSignedUrl(BUCKETS.directoryPhotos ?? 'directory-photos', photo_path, SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS)`, cached with TanStack for `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS` when rendered client-side), name, city/region, home phone, adults' first names (from `listPersonsForHousehold`, batched: one `directory_persons` query with `household_id in (...)` — add `listPersonsForHouseholds(householdIds)` to `queries/directory.ts` if 1.7a lacks it), privacy badges ("Hidden from fellowship", "Hidden from congregation", "Awaiting family confirmation" when `privacy_confirmed_at` is null), and a person count. Toolbar: search input (debounced, updates `?q=`), "New household" button, total count. Empty state: "No households yet — create the first one or import a CSV (step 5.7)". Pagination: previous/next with 50 per page.
3. **Create household** `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/directory/households/new/page.tsx` + `src/features/directory/HouseholdForm.tsx` (client, RHF + `zodResolver(saveHouseholdSchema)`): fields name (required), address_line1/2, city, region, postal_code, country (default `US`), home_phone, anniversary (date input; stored as ISO date), sort_key (helper: "Defaults to the last name; controls ordering in the directory" — prefill from the name on blur if empty). Server Action `createHouseholdAction(orgSlug, input)` in `src/features/directory/actions.ts`: `requireDirectoryAdmin`, `requireWritable`, parse with `saveHouseholdSchema`, set `org_id = ctx.org.orgId`, call `saveHousehold(db, { payload })`, `revalidatePath` the list, redirect to the household page. After creation show an info callout on the household page: "Because a leader created this household it starts hidden from the fellowship. A household adult confirms the privacy choices from the app (step 5.2) — or you can leave it hidden." Optionally the form offers "Add the first person now" which links to `/directory/persons/new?household=<id>` (5.1b route; render the link, it is fine if it 404s until 5.1b).
4. **Household page** `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/directory/households/[householdId]/page.tsx` + `src/features/directory/HouseholdPage.tsx`: `getHouseholdWithPersons(householdId)`; `notFound()` when the view returns nothing (a household outside the org or invisible to the actor looks identical to a missing one — never leak existence). Sections with ids for anchors: `#details` (the `HouseholdForm` in edit mode → `updateHouseholdAction(orgSlug, householdId, input)` which sends `{ id, ...fields }` to `saveHousehold`; never send `org_id` on update), `#photo`, `#people`, `#privacy`, `#notes`. Header: name, badges as in the list, `view_level` chip shown only in development builds.
5. **Photo upload** `src/features/directory/HouseholdPhoto.tsx` (client) + actions `prepareHouseholdPhotoAction(orgSlug, householdId, { contentType, size })` and `revertHouseholdPhotoAction(orgSlug, householdId, previousPath)`. Flow (DESIGN §6/§7: the storage insert policy requires "a row exists whose `photo_path` equals `name` exactly and the caller … `can_edit_household`"): the action validates `contentType in ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp')` and `size <= 10 * 1024 * 1024` (the `directory-photos` bucket limit — export `DIRECTORY_PHOTO_MAX_BYTES` from `@church/domain/limits.ts` if 1.6a did not; additive only), computes `path = householdPhotoPath(orgId, householdId, crypto.randomUUID())` (keep the `.jpg` extension the helper produces even for png/webp — the DB check only constrains the prefix; record the contentType in the upload), calls `saveHousehold(db, { payload: { id: householdId, photo_path: path } })`, returns `{ path, previousPath }`. The browser then uploads with the user client: `supabase.storage.from('directory-photos').upload(path, file, { contentType: file.type, upsert: false, cacheControl: '3600' })` (a plain upload — 10 MiB does not need tus). On storage failure call `revertHouseholdPhotoAction` (sets `photo_path` back to `previousPath`) and show `mapStorageErrorMessage(error)`; on success invalidate `queryKeys.directory.household(id)` and show the new signed URL. Client-side: downscale with a canvas to max 1600 px on the long edge and re-encode as JPEG quality 0.85 before upload (keeps photos small and normalises HEIC-converted files); keep the original if canvas decoding fails. "Remove photo" = `saveHousehold({ id, photo_path: null })`. Old objects have no delete policy for `authenticated`; they become orphans that the 3.6b cron sweep (> 24 h) removes — write that in a code comment and in `docs/RLS.md`'s known consequences.
6. **People section** `#people`: cards from `directory_persons` for this household — photo, preferred/first + last name, `household_role` label (Head of house / Spouse / Child / Other), `congregation_status` badge, `birthday_display`, `directory_listed = false` → "Unlisted" badge, `deceased_on` → "Deceased" badge; each card links to `/o/<slug>/directory/persons/<id>` (5.1b). Buttons "Add person" → `/directory/persons/new?household=<id>` (5.1b). **Head of house** control (decision 6): a select listing the household's persons whose `household_role in ('head','spouse')` or who are adults by the `@church/domain` `audiences.ts` age helpers (`adult_min_age` from `getSettings(orgId)`), current head preselected. Server Action `setHeadOfHouseAction(orgSlug, householdId, personId, previousHeadNewRole: 'spouse' | 'other')`: `requireDirectoryAdmin`, `requireWritable`; if another person is currently `head`, first `savePerson({ id: currentHead, household_role: previousHeadNewRole })`, then `savePerson({ id: personId, household_role: 'head' })`. Two RPC calls are not atomic — if the second fails, re-run the first with `household_role: 'head'` to restore, surface the error, and leave a `TODO(5.6): replace with an atomic set_head_of_house RPC in the next migration` comment. A 23505 unique-violation from the partial index (if the demotion did not happen) must map to "This household already has a head of house" — add the mapping to `toDomainError` only if 1.6b has no generic 23505 handling (additive, with a unit test).
7. **Privacy section** `#privacy` `src/features/directory/PrivacyPanel.tsx` (client) fed by `getPrivacyState(householdId)`: three switches with helper text — `hide_from_congregation`: "Hide this family from the congregation directory (they still see themselves)" (decision 1); `hide_from_fellowship`: "Hide this family from other churches in the fellowship"; `show_children_in_fellowship`: "Show this family's children to the fellowship (default: adults only)". Direction rule for admins: compute `allowedForAdmin(current, next)` in `src/features/directory/privacy-rules.ts` (pure, unit-tested) — an admin may set `hide_*` from false → true and `show_children_in_fellowship` from true → false, never the reverse; a super admin (`ctx.isSuperAdmin`) may do anything. Disabled switches carry the tooltip "Only a household adult can make the family less private (from the Anacast app)". Confirmation state: `privacy_confirmed_at` null → amber "Awaiting family confirmation — a household adult has not reviewed these settings yet"; otherwise "Confirmed <date>" in the org timezone. Server Action `setHouseholdPrivacyAction(orgSlug, householdId, flags)`: `requireDirectoryAdmin`, `requireWritable`, re-check `allowedForAdmin` server-side (belt and braces — the DB trigger is the real guard), call `setHouseholdPrivacy(db, { hh, hide_fell, hide_cong, show_children })`; map the trigger's direction error key (read the exact key from the catalogue in `9999_init.sql` section (5) / `errors.ts`) to the tooltip sentence. Also show the org-level context: when `organization_settings.directory_share_with_fellowship` is false, a note "Your church does not share its directory with the fellowship (Settings → Directory), so the fellowship toggles have no effect today"; when `directory_share_in_congregation` is false, the same for the congregation toggle.
8. **Leader notes** `#notes` `src/features/directory/LeaderNotes.tsx` (client, reused by 5.1b with `kind='person'`): textarea prefilled from `getHouseholdLeaderNotes(householdId)`, "Save notes" → Server Action `saveLeaderNotesAction(orgSlug, kind, id, notes)` → `saveLeaderNotes(db, { kind, id, notes })`; shows `updated_at` and helper text "Visible only to directory administrators of this church. Never shown to the congregation, the fellowship or the audit log." Max 4000 characters (Zod, additive schema `leaderNotesSchema` in `@church/domain/schemas/directory.ts` if absent).
9. **Queries and keys (additive only).** If `queries/directory.ts` lacks `listPersonsForHouseholds(householdIds)` or `countHouseholds(orgId, query)`, add them with explicit column lists from the views only; extend `queryKeys.directory` with `.count(orgId, query)` if used. Update `packages/db/README.md` accordingly. No SQL changes: if a needed RPC behaviour is missing (for example a non-directory-admin path), record it in HANDOFF "Deviations from plan" rather than editing `9999_init.sql` (frozen once pasted — check the ledger).
10. **Docs.** `docs/RLS.md`: add a "Directory admin UI (5.1a)" paragraph — which RPC each control calls, the direction rule as implemented, the orphaned-photo consequence, and that `hide_from_congregation` now has a UI (decision 1). Update `docs/ACCEPTANCE_WEB.md` (3.8) with a short directory click-through: create household → upload photo → set head → toggle privacy toward private (works) → toward public (blocked with tooltip) → write leader notes.
11. **Tests.** Vitest: `privacy-rules.test.ts` (every transition × admin/super), `HouseholdForm` schema mapping (sort_key prefill, empty strings → null), `setHeadOfHouseAction` ordering with a mocked `@church/db` (demote → promote → restore on failure). Playwright smoke (`apps/web/e2e/directory.spec.ts`, `smoke` project, mock env from 3.7a): unauthenticated `/o/any/directory` redirects to `/login?next=…`; `/o/any/directory/households/new` likewise; the strict security headers hold on those URLs (`expectStrictHeaders`). Add an env-gated scenario to `e2e/full/01-acceptance.spec.ts` only if the 3.7b harness makes it a small addition (create household → appears in list); otherwise leave a `test.fixme` with the steps.

## Constraints
- Reads only through `directory_households` / `directory_persons` / `org_directory_info` and the two leader-notes tables; never `select` from `persons` or `households` base tables (the 1.7a spy test enforces this in `@church/db` — keep web code on the query modules, no ad-hoc `.from('households')`). Writes only through the RPC wrappers; the service client is never used in this step.
- Every page and action: `requireOrgMember` → `requireDirectoryAdmin`; mutations also `requireWritable`. Server Actions receive `orgSlug` and never trust a client-supplied org id; `householdId`/`personId` are validated as uuids with Zod before use.
- Do not build persons CRUD, congregation status, account linking, CSV import, the member web directory or mobile screens (5.1b, 5.2, 5.7). Do not add columns, RPCs or policies; do not touch `supabase/migrations/`. Never `supabase db push`/`db reset`.
- Pins: Next 16.3, React 19.2.3, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, RHF + `zodResolver`, TanStack Query, Vitest 4, Playwright 1.62 — add no new dependency (canvas downscaling uses the browser API). No model identifiers in commits or files; no secrets; `<FOUNDER_EMAIL>`-style placeholders only.
- Neutral theme tokens from 2.1's `brand.ts`/`@theme` only; no hard-coded brand colours.

## Verify
- `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` → every task succeeds; the new Vitest files run and pass.
- `pnpm --filter web build` → succeeds with no new warnings; the route list shows `/o/[orgSlug]/directory`, `/o/[orgSlug]/directory/households/new`, `/o/[orgSlug]/directory/households/[householdId]`.
- `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` (3.7a script) → green including `directory.spec.ts`.
- `grep -rn "from('households')\|from('persons')" apps/web/src packages/db/src` → no output.
- Manual (needs the founder's hosted project + Vercel preview or `pnpm --filter web dev` with real env): as the church admin, create a household, upload a 2 MB JPEG (thumbnail appears; `storage.objects` has one row under `<org>/households/<id>/`), set head of house, switch `hide_from_fellowship` on (allowed) and off (blocked with the tooltip; the DB also refuses if forced via devtools), save leader notes, then sign in as a plain member: `/o/<slug>/directory` → 403 page, and the `directory_persons` view hides the notes and the year of the anniversary.

## Finish
- `HANDOFF.md`: feature table row "Directory (households, persons, photos, privacy override)" → Web UI "households done (5.1a), persons 5.1b"; State checklist Phase 2 line updated; under "Deviations from plan" record: DESIGN §9's "`hide_from_congregation` toggle hidden in UI" is superseded by founder decision 1; head-of-house is two `save_person` calls pending an atomic RPC; any additive `@church/db`/`@church/domain` helpers you introduced (names).
- Tick step 5.1a in `docs/TODO.md`; write `session_log.md`; commit `feat(web): directory admin — households list, search, create/edit, photo, privacy, head of house, leader notes`; push `main` (or the branch I named).
- If anything in the plan proves impossible or wrong (for example `save_person` refusing `household_role = 'head'` for admins, or the direction-rule error key differing from the catalogue), do the closest correct thing, record it in HANDOFF.md under "Deviations from plan", and report it in your final message.
done_when: A member holding `users.create` or `org.settings` sees a Directory item in the org navigation; a member without either gets the 403 page on `/o/<slug>/directory` and every `/directory/*` URL.

`/o/<slug>/directory` lists households from `directory_households` with search (`?q=` matches household and person names), 50-per-page pagination, photo thumbnails via signed URLs, privacy badges and an 'Awaiting family confirmation' badge when `privacy_confirmed_at` is null.

`/o/<slug>/directory/households/new` creates a household through `save_household` (with `org_id`), redirects to the household page, and the new household has `hide_from_fellowship = true` and `created_via = 'admin'`.

The household page edits details through `save_household({id, …})`, uploads a JPEG/PNG/WebP up to 10 MiB to `directory-photos` at `householdPhotoPath(orgId, householdId, uuid)` only after the row's `photo_path` was set by the RPC, reverts the path when the upload fails, and 'Remove photo' nulls the path.

Privacy switches call `set_household_privacy`; for a directory admin only transitions toward more privacy are enabled (hide_* false→true, show_children true→false), the reverse is disabled with the tooltip, a super admin may do either, and `privacy-rules.test.ts` covers every transition.
Head of house can be designated among the household's adults; after the action exactly one person in the household has `household_role = 'head'` and the previous head has the role the admin chose.

Leader notes load from `household_leader_notes` and save through `save_leader_notes('household', id, notes)` with a 4000-character limit; a non-admin member cannot read them (RLS) and the UI states they are never shared.

`grep -rn "from('households')\|from('persons')" apps/web/src packages/db/src` prints nothing; `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test`, `pnpm --filter web build` and `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` are green; docs/RLS.md and docs/ACCEPTANCE_WEB.md have the directory paragraphs; HANDOFF.md and docs/TODO.md are updated.

steps.title: Directory admin (web) — persons: create/edit/delete, congregation status, contacts, photo, account linking, person leader notes
steps.goal: A directory administrator adds people to a household and edits them at `/o/<slug>/directory/persons/new?household=<id>` and `/o/<slug>/directory/persons/<personId>`: names, sex, birthdate with its visibility, marital status, household role, `directory_listed`, `deceased_on`, contact fields and a person photo through `save_person`; sets `congregation_status` and `member_since` through `set_congregation_status`; overrides youth membership (`youth_override`); writes person leader notes; links or unlinks the person to a user account (`save_person` with `user_id`, never for a minor) and jumps to the 3.2b Invite / Create-account dialogs with the person preselected; deletes a person through `delete_person`. Derived audience membership (youth / men / women) is shown as badges so the admin can see the effect of ages and overrides.

- Database facts: `directory_households` columns `id, org_id, name, address_line1, address_line2, city, region, postal_code, country, home_phone, photo_path, sort_key, anniversary_display` (`YYYY-MM-DD` at admin/household level, `MM-DD` at congregation level, null for fellowship), privacy columns non-null only at admin/household level, `view_level in ('admin','household','congregation','fellowship')`. `directory_persons` columns include `birthday_display` (masked per level and `birthdate_visibility`), `birthdate` (admin/household only), `youth_override`/`member_since` (admin only), `view_level`; fellowship rows exclude minors unless `show_children_in_fellowship` (or the org turned `fellowship_directory_adults_only` off), unlisted, inactive and deceased people. `app.can_edit_household(hh)`: org writable AND (directory admin, OR the caller has a person in that household with `household_role in ('head','spouse')`, OR super admin). `save_person` for non-admins: may set `household_role` only to `child|other` on others (`household_role_not_allowed`), may not set `congregation_status`, `member_since`, `youth_override`, may set `user_id` only to own uid or null, cannot link a minor; a person may always edit their own contact fields. `set_household_privacy` by a household adult: any direction and stamps `privacy_confirmed_by/at` (founder decision 1); admin-created households start with `hide_from_fellowship = true` and `privacy_confirmed_at` null. Storage: `ca_storage_insert` requires a row whose `photo_path` equals the object name and `can_edit_household`; there is no delete/update policy for `authenticated`.
- Founder decisions that apply: 1 (own-congregation hide toggle, adults any direction); 2 (fellowship sees no birth/anniversary years, no leader notes); HANDOFF: "adults only by default; children only if the family opts in; admin-entered households start hidden from the fellowship until a family adult confirms"; decision 6 (one `head`; "Directory admins and household adults may set it (step 5.1 / 5.2)").

## Build
1. **Dependencies** (mobile versions ONLY via `npx expo install`, run inside `apps/mobile`): `npx expo install expo-image-picker expo-image-manipulator expo-file-system` (skip any already present; `expo-file-system` may already be installed by 4.2a). Add the `expo-image-picker` config plugin to `app.config.ts` with `photosPermission: "Anacast uses your photos to add a family or profile picture to the church directory."` and `cameraPermission` similar. Record the installed versions in HANDOFF "Version pins worth remembering". No `react-native-*`/`expo-*` version literals typed by hand.
2. **Data hooks** `src/features/directory/hooks.ts`: `useHouseholds(orgId, query)` (`queryKeys.directory.households(orgId, query)`, `listHouseholds` with `limit 200` then client-side search on `name`/`sort_key` — the whole congregation fits; page with `offset` only when the first page is full), `useHouseholdPersons(householdIds)` (`listPersonsForHouseholds`), `useHousehold(id)` (`getHouseholdWithPersons`), `usePerson(id)`, `useFellowshipOrgs(orgId)` (`listFellowshipOrgs`), `useFellowshipHouseholds(orgIds)` — `directory_households` where `org_id in (...)`: add `listHouseholdsForOrgs(orgIds, { query })` to `queries/directory.ts` if missing (explicit column list from the view), `usePrivacyState(householdId)`, `useSettings(orgId)`. All persist through the kv persister except signed URLs (already excluded by `shouldPersistQuery`). Default `staleTime` 5 min (4.1a).
3. **Directory home** `app/(app)/directory/index.tsx`: segmented control "Our congregation | Fellowship" (`react-native-paper` `SegmentedButtons`); the Fellowship segment renders only when `useFellowshipOrgs` returns ≥ 1 org. Search bar (`Searchbar`) filters both tabs. Congregation list: `FlatList` of households sorted by `sort_key, name` — avatar (`useSignedUrl('directory-photos', photo_path)` or initials), household name, one line of adult first names (persons with `household_role in ('head','spouse')` or adult by the `audiences.ts` age helpers with the org's `adult_min_age`), city. Empty states: no households → "Your church's directory is empty"; `organization_settings.directory_share_in_congregation = false` (read via `getSettings`; a plain member may read settings — DESIGN §6 `organization_settings` select = member) → "Your church has turned off the congregation directory. You can still see your own household under My household". Fellowship list: `SectionList` with one section per church from `org_directory_info` (`name`, logo via `useSignedUrl('org-assets', logo_path)`), households from `listHouseholdsForOrgs`; the footer explains "Other churches see only what each family shares: no birth years, no anniversaries' years, children only when the family opts in" (decision 2). Tapping a row → `/directory/household/<id>`.
4. **Household detail** `app/(app)/directory/household/[id].tsx` (`src/features/directory/HouseholdDetail.tsx`): photo header, name, address block → `Linking.openURL` with a `geo:0,0?q=<encoded address>` intent on Android (`https://maps.google.com/?q=` fallback), `home_phone` → `tel:`; `anniversary_display` rendered as "Anniversary: Sep 14" (MM-DD) or full date when the level exposes it; people list from `listPersonsForHousehold` (avatar, name, role label, `birthday_display` formatted "Birthday: Mar 3" or with year when present) → `/directory/person/<id>`. When `view_level === 'household'` show an "Edit my household" button → `/household`. A church chip shows the org name when the household is from another church (fellowship rows).
5. **Person detail** `app/(app)/directory/person/[id].tsx`: photo, preferred/first + last name, role, `congregation_status` chip (Member / Attendee) shown only at congregation/household/admin level, contact actions as `IconButton`s: `mobile_phone` → `tel:`/`sms:`, `work_phone` → `tel:`, `email` → `mailto:`; birthday line; "Household" link. Nothing else — the view already withheld what the viewer may not see.
6. **My household** `app/(app)/household/index.tsx` (`src/features/household/MyHousehold.tsx`): from `useActiveOrg().householdId`; if null → EmptyState "You are not linked to a directory household yet — ask your church's directory administrator" (a `TODO(5.6)` comment for join requests). Otherwise `getHouseholdWithPersons(householdId)` with edit affordances when `canEdit = ownPerson.household_role in ('head','spouse')` (mirror of `app.can_edit_household`; compute in `src/features/household/rules.ts`, unit-tested) AND the org is writable (`org.status in ('trial','active','past_due')`; otherwise show the read-only reason). Rows: Details (→ `/household/edit`), People (each → `/household/person/<id>`; "Add a person" → `/household/person/new`), Photo, Head of house, Privacy (→ `/household/privacy`), and the confirmation banner (item 10). A person who is not an adult may still edit **their own** contact fields: their own row opens `/household/person/<id>` in "contacts only" mode.
7. **Edit household** `app/(app)/household/edit.tsx`: form (react-hook-form + `zodResolver(saveHouseholdSchema)` — install nothing; RHF is already in the mobile app if 4.1b used it, otherwise use Paper `TextInput`s with manual Zod parse) for name, address lines, city, region, postal code, country, home phone, anniversary (date picker: use `@react-native-community/datetimepicker` via `npx expo install` only if 4.x has not added a picker; otherwise a masked `YYYY-MM-DD` text field), sort key. Save → `saveHousehold(db, { payload: { id, ...fields } })` (never `org_id`); invalidate `queryKeys.directory.household(id)` and the households list; errors via `toDomainError` → friendly text (`organization_suspended` → "Your church's account is suspended; changes are disabled").
8. **Edit / add person** `app/(app)/household/person/[id].tsx` (`[id] = 'new'` for create): fields first/last/preferred name, sex, birthdate + `birthdate_visibility` (explainer: "Month and day only" default; "the fellowship never sees the year"), marital status, role limited to **Child / Other** for non-admins (the RPC raises `household_role_not_allowed` otherwise — show the picker with only those two, plus a note "Head of house and spouse are set from the household screen"), `directory_listed`, contacts, photo. Non-admins never see `congregation_status`, `member_since`, `youth_override`, `deceased_on`, `user_id` controls. Create sends `{ org_id, household_id, ... }`; edit sends `{ id, ... }`. "Contacts only" mode (own row, not an adult) shows preferred name, email, mobile/work phone only. Delete person is NOT offered on mobile (admins do it on the web) — say so in the UI footer.
9. **Head of house** (decision 6) `src/features/household/HeadOfHouse.tsx` on the My household screen: picker over the household's adults; on change call `savePerson({ id: newHead, household_role: 'head' })` after demoting the current head to `spouse` (if the current head is the new head's spouse — ask with a two-option dialog "Spouse / Other") exactly like 5.1a's two-call sequence with restore-on-failure. **Known conflict to handle**: the 1.3b `save_person` rule says non-admins may only set `child|other` on others, which would block a household adult from designating a head; decision 6 says household adults may. Try the calls; when the RPC raises `household_role_not_allowed`, show "Only a directory administrator can change the head of house right now — ask your church" and record in HANDOFF "Deviations from plan" that 1.3b blocks decision 6 for households (the fix — allow a household adult to move `head` between adults of their own household, or a `set_head_of_house` RPC — belongs to the next migration, 5.6's `9998_*`). Do not edit `9999_init.sql`.
10. **Privacy screen** `app/(app)/household/privacy.tsx` (`src/features/household/PrivacyScreen.tsx`): an explainer card first — who sees what at each level (congregation: everything the family lists incl. birthday month/day and, if chosen, the year; fellowship: names, address, phones, emails, photos, birthday month/day, no years, adults only unless you opt children in; leaders: everything plus leader notes; "You can hide your family from your own congregation too" — decision 1). Three switches: "Hide from our congregation" (`hide_from_congregation`), "Hide from other churches in the fellowship" (`hide_from_fellowship`), "Show our children to the fellowship" (`show_children_in_fellowship`, disabled with explanation when hidden from the fellowship). Context lines when the org has `directory_share_with_fellowship = false` ("Your church does not share with a fellowship, so this switch has no effect today") or `directory_share_in_congregation = false`. "Save" → `setHouseholdPrivacy(db, { hh: householdId, hide_fell, hide_cong, show_children })` — household adults may move any direction; the RPC stamps `privacy_confirmed_*`. Non-adults see the switches read-only with "Only a household adult (head of house or spouse) can change these". Success toast "Saved — your privacy choices are confirmed". Last line: "Changes are recorded in your church's audit log".
11. **Confirmation flow for admin-created households**: `usePrivacyState(householdId)`; when `privacy_confirmed_at` is null and the member is a household adult, show a persistent banner on Home (`(tabs)/home.tsx`, small edit) and on My household: "A leader added your family to the directory. Your family is hidden from other churches until you review your privacy choices" → "Review" opens `/household/privacy` in confirm mode: the current values are preselected and the primary button reads "Confirm these choices" (calls `set_household_privacy` with the same values — stamping the confirmation). Remember dismissal for 7 days in kv (`privacy_banner_dismissed_at`) but never hide it permanently until confirmed.
12. **Photos (ArrayBuffer)** `src/lib/photo-upload.ts` + `src/features/household/PhotoPicker.tsx`: `ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({ mediaTypes: ['images'], quality: 1, allowsEditing: true, aspect: [1, 1] })` (or camera), then `ImageManipulator` to resize the long edge to 1200 px and export JPEG at 0.85 (use the `ImageManipulator.manipulate(uri).resize(...).renderAsync()` / `saveAsync({ format: SaveFormat.JPEG, compress: 0.85 })` API of the installed version — read its typings), then read bytes with the new `expo-file-system` `File` API (`new File(uri).arrayBuffer()`) or `fetch(uri).then(r => r.arrayBuffer())` as DESIGN §7 allows — **never a Blob on React Native**. Flow: `savePerson`/`saveHousehold` with the planned `photo_path` (`personPhotoPath(orgId, personId, crypto.randomUUID())` via `expo-crypto` `randomUUID()` — already a dependency from 4.1a) → `supabase.storage.from('directory-photos').upload(path, arrayBuffer, { contentType: 'image/jpeg', upsert: false })` → on failure revert the path with the same RPC and show `mapStorageErrorMessage`. Enforce `DIRECTORY_PHOTO_MAX_BYTES` after compression (retry at 0.7 once, then refuse). Invalidate the signed-URL query for the old path. Unit-test the pure `planPhotoUpload(kind, ids)` and `pickCompression(bytes)` helpers.
13. **Navigation**: More tab rows "Directory" (→ `/directory`) and "My household" (→ `/household`) (DESIGN §10: "Phase 2/3 add Directory, Calendar, Documents, Surveys, My household"). Register the new routes in the `(app)` stack layout with titles. Deep-link paths `/directory/household/<id>` and `/directory/person/<id>` work through expo-router; add them to the `parseAppLink` allow-list (4.1b) if it filters paths.
14. **Docs**: `docs/MEDIA.md` — a "Directory photos (mobile)" section (picker → manipulator → ArrayBuffer → upload; 10 MiB; orphan sweep). `docs/RLS.md` — "Mobile self-service" paragraph listing which screen calls which RPC and the head-of-house conflict if you hit it. `docs/MOBILE_BUILD.md` — the new photo permissions strings.

## Constraints
- Reads only through `directory_households`, `directory_persons`, `org_directory_info`, `organization_settings`; never the `persons`/`households` base tables, never `household_leader_notes`/`person_leader_notes` (RLS would return nothing for members, but do not even query them). Writes only via `save_household`, `save_person`, `set_household_privacy`. The mobile app holds only `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` / `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` — no elevated keys, no server code.
- Mobile native dependency versions come only from `npx expo install`; `react` stays `catalog:` (19.2.3). Do not add web-only packages. Do not import from `apps/web`.
- Do not build calendars/events (5.3), join codes (5.6), CSV import, delete-person on mobile, or any migration. Do not change `9999_init.sql`; never `supabase db push`/`db reset`.
- Never persist signed URLs or photo bytes in the query cache; never log personal data. No model identifiers, no secrets.

## Verify
- `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` → every task succeeds; new tests (`rules.test.ts` for `canEditHousehold`/adult detection, `photo-upload.test.ts`, privacy explainer copy snapshot optional) pass.
- `cd apps/mobile && npx expo-doctor` → all checks pass (or the same known exclusions 4.1a recorded); `npx expo export --platform android` → bundle written with no errors; `pnpm --filter mobile typecheck` clean.
- `grep -rn "new Blob\|from('persons')\|from('households')\|leader_notes" apps/mobile/src apps/mobile/app` → no output.
- `grep -n "expo-image-picker\|expo-image-manipulator" apps/mobile/package.json` → versions present, matching `npx expo install --check` (no drift reported).
- Manual (founder's device with a preview build, or after 4.5): sign in as a household head of an admin-created household → Home shows the review banner → Privacy → "Confirm these choices" → banner gone and `households.privacy_confirmed_at` set (SQL Editor); turn "Hide from our congregation" on → another member no longer sees the household in Our congregation but the family still sees itself under My household; upload a person photo (row in `storage.objects` under `<org>/persons/<id>/`); Fellowship tab (two churches in a fellowship with `directory_share_with_fellowship` on) shows the other church's adults with birthday month/day only.

## Finish
- `HANDOFF.md`: feature table "Directory" Mobile UI → done (5.2); State checklist; "Version pins worth remembering" with the `expo-image-picker` / `expo-image-manipulator` / `expo-file-system` versions installed; "Deviations from plan" for the head-of-house conflict (if hit) and any additive `@church/db` helper (`listHouseholdsForOrgs`).
- Tick step 5.2 in `docs/TODO.md`; write `session_log.md`; commit `feat(mobile): directory tabs, household and person detail, household self-service, privacy confirmation`; push `main` (or the branch I named).
- If anything in the plan proves impossible or wrong, do the closest correct thing, record it in HANDOFF.md under "Deviations from plan", and report it in your final message.
done_when: More tab has 'Directory' and 'My household' rows; `/directory` shows 'Our congregation' with households from `directory_households` (search, photos via signed URLs, adult names) and a 'Fellowship' segment only when `org_directory_info` returns other churches, grouped by church with logos.

Household and person detail screens render only view-exposed fields (`anniversary_display`, `birthday_display`, contacts) with tel:/sms:/mailto:/maps actions; a fellowship household shows no years and no minors unless the family opted in — verified by reading the view as a fellowship member.

A household adult edits household details and adds/edits people through `save_household` / `save_person`; the role picker offers only Child/Other for others; a non-adult member can edit only their own contact fields; delete is not offered on mobile.

Privacy screen explains the three levels and saves `hide_from_congregation`, `hide_from_fellowship`, `show_children_in_fellowship` through `set_household_privacy`; after saving, `privacy_confirmed_at` is set and the 'Review your family's directory privacy' banner disappears; non-adults see the switches read-only.

Photos are picked with expo-image-picker, resized/re-encoded with expo-image-manipulator, uploaded as an ArrayBuffer (no Blob) to `directory-photos` at the path the RPC set first, with revert on failure and a 10 MiB guard; `grep 'new Blob' apps/mobile` is empty.

Head of house can be changed by a household adult, or — if `save_person` raises `household_role_not_allowed` — the app explains that a directory administrator must do it and HANDOFF records the 1.3b/decision-6 conflict.

`expo-image-picker`, `expo-image-manipulator` (and `expo-file-system` if new) were added with `npx expo install`, their versions are in HANDOFF, `app.config.ts` carries the picker plugin permission strings, and `npx expo-doctor` + `npx expo export --platform android` pass.

`pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` is green with the new `rules.test.ts` and `photo-upload.test.ts`; docs/MEDIA.md, docs/RLS.md and docs/MOBILE_BUILD.md are updated; HANDOFF.md marks the directory Mobile UI done and docs/TODO.md 5.2 is ticked.

steps.title: Calendars & events (web) — calendars CRUD, events list/create/edit/delete, pending approval queue with push
steps.goal: Church leaders manage calendars and events on the web: `/o/<slug>/calendars` lists the four default calendars (All / Youth / Men / Women, created by `app.on_org_created`) plus custom ones and lets `org.settings` holders rename, colour, set the view and submit audience groups, create and delete custom calendars; `/o/<slug>/events` lists upcoming events per calendar with create/edit/delete for `announcements.create` / `announcements.edit` / `announcements.delete` holders (leader-created events are approved immediately and may push); `/o/<slug>/events/pending` is the approval queue where `announcements.edit` holders approve (→ `status = 'approved'`, the `app.on_content_publish` trigger enqueues the push, the 3.6a dispatcher sends it) or reject with a reason. Everything writes directly to `calendars` / `events` under RLS with the user client; no RPC or migration is added.

Build ONLY this step; do not start the next one.

## Goal
When you finish, an `org.settings` holder opens `/o/<slug>/calendars`, sees the church's calendars (`kind` all/youth/men/women plus custom), edits a calendar's name, colour, "Who can see it" (`view_audience_group_id`) and "Who can submit events" (`submit_audience_group_id`) from the church's `audience_groups`, adds a custom calendar and deletes a custom one (with its events). An `announcements.create` holder opens `/o/<slug>/events`, filters by calendar and month, creates an event (calendar, title, description, location, start/end in the church timezone, all-day, push) that is approved at once, edits it (`announcements.edit`), deletes it (`announcements.delete`). `/o/<slug>/events/pending` shows member-submitted events awaiting approval with Approve (push is enqueued by the trigger and dispatched by 3.6a's `afterContentPublish`) and Reject (reason stored in `rejection_reason`). Members without those permissions see 403 on these pages (the member experience is mobile, 5.3b). Lint, typecheck, tests, the web build and the Playwright smoke project are green.

## Inputs / prior state
- Org shell and guards (3.1): `requireOrgMember(slug)` → `OrgContext`, `requirePerm(ctx, perm | perms[])`, `requireWritable(ctx)`, `NAV_ITEMS` in `src/features/org/nav.ts`, `ActionResult` / `toActionError`, `src/lib/dates.ts` (`zonedLocalToInstant`, `instantToZonedLocal`, `formatInstantInZone`, `formatDateOnly`), `StatusBanner`, `maxDuration = 60` convention on pages whose Server Actions dispatch push (3.5a/3.6a).
- Announcements (3.5a) and push (3.6a): `src/features/announcements/{AnnouncementForm,AudienceGroupSelect or equivalent,PushStatusBadge,pushStatusLabel}` — reuse the audience-group select and the publish-time picker (org timezone) rather than rewriting them; `afterContentPublish({ orgId })` in `src/lib/push/after-publish.ts` runs the dispatcher synchronously after a publish; `getDeliveryCounts` Server Action for per-notification counts; `listNotificationStatus` with a `kind` filter in `@church/db` `queries/notifications.ts`. The dispatcher (3.6a) already handles `kind = 'event'`: it re-reads `events` and sends only when `status = 'approved' and push`, deep-link `notificationTargetPath('event', id)` = `/events/<id>`.
- Settings (3.1): `organization_settings.members_can_submit_events` (default true) and `events_require_approval` (default true) are editable under `/settings#events`.
- `@church/db` (1.7a, 3.6a): `queries/audience-groups.ts` `listAudienceGroups(orgId)` (system rows first in `SYSTEM_AUDIENCE_GROUPS` order, then custom); 3.6a may have created `queries/calendars-events.ts` with a minimal `getEvent(id)` — extend that file, do not create a second module; `queryKeys` factory; `unwrap*`.
- `@church/domain`: `schemas/enums.ts` (`calendarKindSchema`, `eventStatusSchema` — values `pending | approved | rejected | cancelled`), `SYSTEM_AUDIENCE_GROUPS`, `dates.ts`, `errors.ts` (`organization_suspended`, `invalid_payload`), `urls.ts` `notificationTargetPath`.
